title: Send response
description: A newly sent bubble appears immediately, with a short entrance that runs once. Echoes, history and reconnect never replay it. Reduced motion shows the final state directly. Exact motion timing remains provisional until the iOS reference is restored.

title: Double-tap reactions
description: Double-tap or hold text, a photo, a video or a voice message to open the existing reactions. Selecting again removes your own reaction; choosing another changes it. Back closes the menu and keeps the chat. Dismissing the menu keeps a previously closed keyboard closed.

title: Who reacted
description: Tap a reaction badge to see who reacted and how. Use phone contacts or explicit participant names; a custom conversation title cannot become a person's name.

title: Swipe to reply
description: Drag a bubble right, release past the reply threshold, and reply to that message. A short drag cancels. A single photo supports the same gesture. Existing quote presentation remains until structured threads in group 3.

title: Pull to see times
description: Drag left and hold to reveal message times across the conversation. Let go to return the bubbles to their positions. A timestamp is accessible only while revealed.

title: Conversation actions
description: Hold a conversation for read/unread, pin/unpin and mute/unmute. The same actions are available to accessibility. Pin and mute are stored on this phone; they do not change other Apple devices.

title: Pinned and muted
description: Pinned conversations keep their selected order above recent activity, including after restart. Muting suppresses notifications while retaining unread messages. Unmute restores notifications.

title: Swipe the chat list
description: Swipe left to expose Pin and Mute. Only one row stays open at a time. Swipe right past the threshold to switch read/unread; a short drag returns without changing it.

title: Read state and recovery
description: Read/unread changes appear at once. If the Mac refuses a change, restore the prior count and show the error; retry clears the error. Read state remains separate from message delivery/read receipts.

title: Pinned and muted · unfolded
description: The same local pin/mute state appears in the existing conversation rail. This is the unfolded size of the same behavior, with the existing Shared pane.

title: Conversation actions · unfolded
description: Hold the conversation's rail avatar to open the same actions. No new unfolded feature or separate preference state.

title: Reactions · unfolded
description: The same double-tap reaction menu works beside the existing Shared pane. Back closes the modal and keeps the selected conversation.
